Your safety&mdash;''"<br />"''The knights could ''use'' two more lightsabers on their side.|Marasiah Fel and Thared, as they join the battle on Mala|<ref name="Legacy 18" />}}
'''Thared''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="Legacy 18" /> [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]]<ref name="JCF" /> who served the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] as a Master of the [[Imperial Knight]]s.<ref name="Legacy 18" /> Around [[139 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">The events of [[Legacy (2013) 18|''Legacy'' (2013) 18]] take place approximately 139 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to circa [[139 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Thared accompanied [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]]<ref name="Legacy 18" /> when she led Triumvirate forces to the rogue [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Legacy 17">[[Legacy (2013) 17|''Legacy'' (2013) 17]]</ref> [[Mala (planet)|Mala]],<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2013) 2|''Legacy'' (2013) 2]]</ref> where they [[Battle of the Floating World|confronted]] the acolytes of the [[One Sith]].<ref name="Legacy 17" /> As Fel and Thared watched the battlefield below them aboard the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Neuer]]'', the Empress decided to join the battle herself after the Barabel informed her that their reinforcements would not be arriving soon. Despite Thared's protest out of fear for Fel's safety, the two soon landed on the planet surface along with their [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] guards. Under the Empress's command, the Triumvirate emerged victorious in the battle with the [[Death/Legends|demise]] of all [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] combatants.<ref name="Legacy 18" />

Thared possessed [[Color/Legends|dark green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin. As an Imperial Knight, the Barabel wore the standard [[Imperial Knight armor|red armor]], including black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Cape/Legends|cape]], and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Legacy 18" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The brothers' ''Star Wars'' history has its own unique plot twist, thanks to author Corinna Bechko, who honored the duo by combining their names into that of a new character&mdash;Thared&mdash;in her Legends-branded comic-book series, ''Star Wars: Legacy''.|"[[Worldwide]]" department, [[Star Wars Insider 202|''Star Wars Insider'' 202]]|<ref name="Insider 202">{{InsiderCite|202|Worldwide}}</ref>}}
[[File:BechkoHardman-signing.jpg|thumb|left|290px|Peppard brothers meet Corinna Bechko (center) and Gabriel Hardman (right), authors of the 2013 ''Star Wars: Legacy'' series, at a comic-book signing.]]
Thared appeared in the [[Legacy (2013) 18|eighteenth and final issue]] of the [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 2|''Star Wars: Legacy'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, which was written by [[Corinna Bechko]] and [[Gabriel Hardman]], illustrated by [[Brian Albert Thies]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 18" /> on [[August 27]], [[2014]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/23-648/Star-Wars-Legacy-18|text=Star Wars: Legacy #18}}</ref> The character was named after brothers Jared and Theo Peppard, two ''[[Star Wars]]'' fans, upon the former's fan email to Bechko, asking the author if she could use a [[Tuckerization|combination]] of their names for a minor character.<ref name="TalkStarWars">{{WebCite|url=https://www.talkstarwars.co.uk/news/our-star-wars-legacy-guest-blogger-jared-peppard|text=Our Star Wars Legacy|author=Jared Peppard|date=2017-07-14|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20180901171642/https://www.talkstarwars.co.uk TalkStarWars.co.uk]|archivedate=20170722011435|nolive=1}}</ref> Although the series was close to being finalized at that point, Bechko managed to find a role the character could fill and later stated that she was glad that role was a "heroic person" rather than a villain.<ref name="Interview">{{YouTube|video=_W8tv0zNsHU|text=TSW Comics &#124; Episode 003 - Corinna Bechko Interview|channel=@TalkStarWars|name=Talk Star Wars|date=2017-07-19}}</ref> Additionally, Hardman clarified that Thared was a member of the Barabel [[Species/Legends|species]] in response to a fan question about whether the character was a Barabel or a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] on [[TheForce.net]]'s [[Jedi Council Forums]].<ref name="JCF" />
